title: HostCover Schedule of Category Sublimits and Lost-Income Cover
content:
Within **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**, four damage categories carry their own ceiling on a single claim, and lost booking income is covered only on some levels. This schedule gives those figures for every level.

## Category sublimits (most paid on one claim of that category)

| HostCover level | Pet damage (USD) | Deep cleaning (USD) | Theft (USD) | Valuables: art, jewellery, collectibles (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 (not covered) |
| HostCover Standard | 2500.00 | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | 0.00 (not covered) |
| HostCover Plus | 5000.00 | 2000.00 | 10000.00 | 2500.00 |
| HostCover Premier | 10000.00 | 3500.00 | 25000.00 | 10000.00 |
| HostCover Elite | 25000.00 | 5000.00 | 50000.00 | 50000.00 |
| HostCover Estate | 50000.00 | 10000.00 | 100000.00 | 250000.00 |

A valuables sublimit of 0.00 means valuables are not covered at that level.

## Lost-income cover

| HostCover level | Lost income covered | Most cancelled nights paid on one income-loss claim |
|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | No | 0 |
| HostCover Standard | No | 0 |
| HostCover Plus | Yes | 7 |
| HostCover Premier | Yes | 14 |
| HostCover Elite | Yes | 30 |
| HostCover Estate | Yes | 60 |

"Lost income covered" states whether bookings the host had to cancel because of guest damage are covered. Where it is not covered, the nights figure is 0.

**How lost income is valued (every level):** the nightly subtotal of each confirmed stay the host had to cancel because the damage made the listing unusable.

## Questions this schedule answers

**Are art, jewellery and collectibles covered on HostCover Standard?** No. Its valuables sublimit is 0.00, which means not covered. Valuables are covered from HostCover Plus upward.

**What is the ceiling on one theft claim at HostCover Premier?** 25000.00, the Premier theft sublimit.

**Which levels cover lost income?** HostCover Plus, HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite and HostCover Estate, with 7, 14, 30 and 60 nights respectively as the most cancelled nights paid on one income-loss claim.
